name: Graph-Based Distributed Partitioning
aliases: Offline Point Placement via Bipartite Graph Partitioning
definition: An offline technique for assigning 3D Gaussian points to machines/GPUs by partitioning a bipartite graph using the METIS library, designed to reduce communication overhead compared to random distribution.
summary: Graph-Based Distributed Partitioning assigns 3D points to GPUs by modeling data access as a bipartite graph to minimize cross-partition communication, explicitly accounting for camera-view frustum overlap rather than pure spatial proximity.
